about.registryInfo: Alter SPV Investments holds approximately 1% non-dilutive minority equity in PT Solarisia Energi Indonesia, an Indonesian limited liability company, with differential voting rights per applicable shareholder and investment documentation. The interest is held through one or more legal entities or SPVs controlled by Alter SPV Investments. The SOLA token represents a beneficial interest in that investment structure on the XRP Ledger. PT Solarisia Energi Indonesia manufactures solar modules and energy infrastructure for commercial, industrial, utility-scale, agricultural, and remote-power applications.
